Notification made by Chief Minister of the Central Province Provincial Council

VESTING OF POWERS UNDER CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES STATUTE No. 10 OF THE CENTRALPROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL AS AMENDED BY CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES (AMENDMENT)STATUTE No. 04 OF THE 1993 OF THE CENTRAL PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
